source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The test awaits open_message_from_file, whose helper waits for message display, then calls MsgBodyAllowHTML before reading the current document. MsgBodyAllowHTML only sets preferences and contains no reload. The expected text assertion still checks the displayed fixture, but the comment does not establish that the fixture loaded in Original HTML mode. If that mode is a prerequisite, set its preferences through the applicable harness setup before loading. This is a static setup/comment finding, not a demonstrated failure.
title: The untyped-text test changes display preferences after its initial message load
